clue.text: Is article about a so-called beauty queen of Europe?

parts.note: A is the indefinite article

indicators.note: so-called here means called out, so the word for a beauty is taken by its sound

parts.note: a belle is a beautiful woman

explanation.surface: A question about whether a magazine piece concerns a European beauty pageant winner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'so-called' turns BELLE into its sound-alike BELL; 'about' is a link meaning 'concerning'. Isabella was the queen of Castile who backed Columbus.
explanation.definitionFit: Isabella I ruled Castile, a Spanish kingdom, making her a European monarch.

clue.text: Aforementioned navigator going North

indicators.note: in a down clue, going north means the letters are read upwards

parts.note: Bartolomeu Dias was the Portuguese navigator who rounded the Cape of Good Hope

explanation.surface: An explorer already mentioned sets off towards the north.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean previously mentioned, as in legal or formal writing.

clue.text: Shrewd monarch's publicity material

parts.note: fly is informal British for sharp or knowing
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the queen, plus the possessive S

explanation.surface: Leaflets put out by a canny king or queen.
explanation.definitionFit: Flyers are handbills or leaflets advertising something.

clue.text: Writer, who did philosophy the French way, so to speak

indicators.note: to speak signals the words before are taken by how they sound when said

parts.note: rue is French for street, a way, followed by so as written

explanation.surface: A thinker who approached philosophy in the French manner.
explanation.walkthrough: RUE plus SO said together sound like the name of Jean-Jacques Rousseau.
explanation.definitionFit: Jean-Jacques Rousseau was an author and philosopher of the Enlightenment.

clue.text: Computer used to land aircraft

parts.note: a micro is a microcomputer
to light is to alight or come down, to land

explanation.surface: A computer guides an aeroplane down onto the runway.
explanation.definitionFit: A microlight is a very small, light aeroplane.

clue.text: Homer, for example, speaking a mixture of languages

indicators.note: speaking signals the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: a pidgin is a simplified mixed language used between groups

explanation.surface: The poet Homer speaking in a blend of tongues.
explanation.walkthrough: Homer looks like the Greek poet; here it is a homing bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A homer is a homing pigeon, trained to fly back to its loft.

clue.text: Piece of ornamental edging destroyed in collapse

indicators.note: something destroyed is broken up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Decorative trim ruined when something fell down.
explanation.definitionFit: An escallop is a scallop, a curved shape used in a series as a decorative border.

clue.text: Clothing seen on a couple of 22 down

definitions.meaning: swimming shorts worn by a man

definitions.text: seen on a couple of 22 down
definitions.meaning: two elephants between them carry two of their long noses

explanation.definitionFit: Bathing shorts are sold as these, and each elephant has one long nose.

clue.text: Where axes cut roots

definitions.meaning: on a graph, the point where the x and y axes cross

explanation.definitionFit: Origin is the source of something and also the zero point where graph axes meet.

clue.text: Having retired, get an educational qualification

parts.note: a BEd is a Bachelor of Education degree

explanation.surface: After retiring, someone goes back to study for a teaching degree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Having retired' means having gone to bed, not stopped work.
explanation.definitionFit: Retired here means gone to bed for the night, so in bed.

clue.text: Agents giving English girl a sign

parts.note: a miss is a girl or young woman
Aries is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: Spies hand an English girl a signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Emissaries are agents sent on a mission by others.

clue.text: Tools for growing things with 19

explanation.definitionFit: Planes are both carpenter's smoothing tools and plane trees.

clue.text: Take care of railway workers and horticulturalists

parts.note: to nurse is to look after
men are workers in crosswords

explanation.surface: Look after the rail staff and the gardeners.
explanation.definitionFit: Nurserymen raise and sell plants, so they are professional gardeners.

clue.text: By implication, too many deliveries becoming tedious

definitions.meaning: a cricket over is six balls, so one that went on too long has too many

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is a set of six deliveries (bowled balls).
explanation.definitionFit: Something overlong drags on so much that it becomes boring.

clue.text: Scam involving Cockney chap creates commotion

indicators.note: involving means the word for scam wraps round the other piece

parts.note: a con is a swindle
'Arry is Harry with the H dropped, as a Cockney (London) speaker says it

explanation.surface: A swindle with a London geezer stirs up a fuss.
explanation.definitionFit: A carry-on is a fuss or palaver, informal British.

clue.text: Liberal policy in West Coast state, welcoming writer to party circle

indicators.note: welcoming means the state abbreviation takes the other pieces inside

parts.note: OR is the abbreviation for Oregon
a pen writes
a do is a party
O is circle-shaped

explanation.surface: A permissive policy in Oregon lets an author into the party ring.
explanation.definitionFit: An open-door policy freely admits people or trade, a liberal approach.

clue.text: Eg cases of fruit put on box for fruit

indicators.note: put on means one piece comes after the other in an across answer

parts.note: a lug is a shallow box for carrying fruit
a gage is a greengage, a kind of plum

explanation.surface: Crates of fruit stacked on top of a fruit box.
explanation.definitionFit: Luggage is bags and suitcases taken on a journey.

clue.text: Cast off when finished working on this island

definitions.text: Cast off when finished working on this
definitions.meaning: a knitted sweater, whose stitches are cast off once knitting ends

explanation.walkthrough: A guernsey is a thick knitted jumper (sweater) named after the island.
explanation.definitionFit: Guernsey is a Channel Island and the woollen sweater named after it.

clue.text: See 8
Driver of caravan has brawl in vehicle

indicators.note: in means the brawl goes inside the vehicle

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
a melee is a confused fight

explanation.surface: A man towing a caravan gets into a fight in his car.
explanation.definitionFit: A cameleer drives camels, and a caravan is a desert camel train.

clue.text: American taking test, not caring if right or wrong

definitions.text: not caring if right or wrong

parts.note: an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: An American sits an exam without worrying about the answers.
explanation.definitionFit: Amoral means without moral sense, indifferent to right and wrong.

clue.text: Precious stone put in place for rich 3 on 12 such as 22 down

parts.note: jet is a black gemstone
to set is to place

explanation.surface: A gem is mounted in its setting.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as wealthy flyers (3) on planes (12) such as jumbos (22 down).
explanation.definitionFit: The jet set are rich people who fly around the world for pleasure.

clue.text: Big things Jack presented to bosses

parts.note: J is the abbreviation for jack in cards
an umbo is the central boss of a shield

explanation.surface: A man named Jack is introduced to his managers.
explanation.definitionFit: Jumbo means something very large, such as an elephant or jet.

clue.text: Element's mass men doubly misrepresented

definitions.note: Element's is Element is, with the 's a link

parts.note: M is the symbol for mass

indicators.note: misrepresented means the letters are given in a false arrangement

explanation.surface: A chemical element's mass misreported twice by men.
explanation.definitionFit: Molybdenum is a metallic chemical element, number 42.

clue.text: Slightly injure football player

definitions.meaning: to graze or hit lightly, as with a bullet
a player on the flank, a winger

explanation.definitionFit: To wing is to wound slightly, and a wing is a flank player in football.

clue.text: A powerful measure, from what we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: these words are said aloud, and what is heard is the sound this part of the answer needs

explanation.surface: A strong yardstick, judging from reports.
explanation.definitionFit: The watt is the unit of power.

clue.text: Over time, short literary work emerged into consciousness

indicators.note: over means the literary work sits over, round, the letter for time

parts.note: a cameo is a short piece of writing

explanation.surface: Over the years a brief piece of writing came to light.
explanation.definitionFit: To come to is to regain consciousness.

clue.text: A couple of seconds on different plane, for example

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for second
a mo is a moment, a second
other means different

explanation.surface: Two seconds spent on another aircraft.
explanation.walkthrough: Two words for a second, S and MO, then OTHER. Plane is the woodworking tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A plane is a tool for smoothing wood, so it is a smoother.
